Definition: Accepted binomial used as the join key across sources (spelling variants unified via sp_alias).
Note: Printed names kept in each source's own CSV; see README aliases.

Definition: Total number of distinct cortical areas/fields identified in the species.
Note: Changizi n_areas; Finlay total_areas. Counts depend on the mapping scheme — comparable only approximately.

Definition: Number of visual cortical areas/fields.
Number of somatomotor cortical areas/fields.
Total (neo)cortical SHEET surface area — the fully UNFOLDED cortical mantle including buried/sulcal cortex, i.e. NOT the exposed/pial surface only. Whole cortex (not a sub-region).
Basis: physically flattened cortex; area measured (Kaas/Krubitzer mapping studies)
Note: Finlay's "total cortical sheet area", from Kaas & Krubitzer flattening studies.

Definition: Total cortical sheet surface area (see above).
Basis: neocortex separated from white matter and manually FLATTENED; per-hemisphere total taken from paper text (piece-sum undercounts)
Note: Per-hemisphere totals from paper text (galago #1 2261, #2 1849, baboon 18577). Macaque 08-59 not flattened → no surface.

Definition: Total cortical sheet surface area (see above).
Basis: neocortex separated from white matter, manually FLATTENED, piece surfaces measured in ImageJ
Note: Reported in cm² → ×100 to mm². Two hemispheres of one specimen averaged first. Case 09-27 (baboon) EXCLUDED as duplicate of Collins.

Definition: REGIONAL sub-trait — surface area of primary motor cortex (M1) ONLY. Never pooled with whole-cortex CorticalSurface_Area.mm2 (trait_class = regional).
Note: Young is the active M1 source. Collins 2016's chimp M1 (2497 mm²) is the SAME specimen as Young's (2700 mm²; KAAS-PAN-11_38, boundary difference) — kept in _long as superseded_by_Young_etal_2013.

Definition: Total cortical sheet surface area (see above).
Basis: physically flattened right hemisphere, areas by structure (reported cm² → ×100)
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. One chimp (Texas Biomedical female, specimen KAAS-PAN-11_38).

Definition: Total cortical sheet surface area (see above). Mota & Herculano-Houzel's AG — TOTAL (pial incl. sulcal) grey surface, per one hemisphere (FI = AG/AE).
Basis: surface reconstruction of dissected hemispheres (Mota/HH lab own dataset)
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. OWN columns only; 2015 "_other" compiled columns never merged. 2019 supersedes 2015 per species×term (values identical where both print).

Definition: EXPOSED (outer envelope) cortical surface area — the pial surface visible without opening sulci (Mota & Herculano-Houzel's AE). Whole cortex; distinct from and never pooled with the total-sheet CorticalSurface_Area.mm2.
Mean cortical (grey-matter) thickness of one hemisphere.
Mota & Herculano-Houzel folding index, FI = AG/AE (total ÷ exposed surface). NOT the Zilles gyrification index — excluded from the GI-only __merging_gyrification and never pooled with GI.
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. Only in the 2015 table; 2019 prints AT and AE, from which FI is derivable but not re-stored.

Definition: REGIONAL sub-trait — surface area of primary visual cortex (V1) only. trait_class = regional; never pooled with whole-cortex surface.
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. Currently one chimp; slot for future V1 surfaces.

Definition: REGIONAL sub-trait — surface area of second visual area (V2) only. trait_class = regional; never pooled with whole-cortex surface.
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. Currently one chimp. Collins 2016's "somatosensory/premotor block" and "Prefrontal Cortex" rows are dissection blocks — NOT wired.

Definition: REGIONAL — primary visual (striate) cortex surface (see above).
Basis: Brodmann 1909 cytoarchitectonic planimetry via Smaers 2017 Table S1
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25, owner decision. SECONDARY (Brodmann-via-Smaers); a future Brodmann-1909 primary build supersedes. 10 primates.

Definition: REGIONAL sub-trait — prefrontal (granular frontal) cortex surface, Brodmann's partition. Never pooled with whole-cortex surface.
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. 9 primates (Saimiri lacks it). Part of Brodmann's 4-region partition — the four regions sum EXACTLY to the Brodmann 1913 per-hemisphere totals for marmoset, gibbon, chimp.

Definition: REGIONAL sub-trait — "other cortical association areas" in Brodmann's 4-region partition (residual category: everything but primary visual, prefrontal, frontal motor).
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. Mandrill cell EXCLUDED: fails additivity vs Brodmann 1913's mandrill total by exactly +10,000 (candidate misprint 23422→13422; not repaired, just excluded).

Definition: REGIONAL sub-trait — Brodmann's agranular frontal ("frontal motor") block. NOT M1: it includes premotor cortex — never map or pool with M1_Surface_Area.mm2.
Total cortical sheet surface area (see above) — Brodmann's Rindenfläche of one hemisphere (includes the tabulated sulcal cortex).
Note: ADDED 2026-08-25. 34 rows wired across mammal orders. Of five human rows only "Europäer: Durchschnitt" (112,471) enters; Max/Min/Naturmenschen/Idioten excluded (envelope/subset/pathological, not species means). Method-level conflicts with modern sources expected and flagged.
